title: Getsuyoubi no Tawawa Specials
justification: AniList: 2 episodes (synonyms "Episode 13", "Episode 14", 5 min, bonus), 2016-12-29, 月曜日のたわわ 特典. The relation is PREQUEL to AniList 97716, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 12462 (docs allow PREQUEL when PARENT is absent). AniDB 12462 lists exactly two specials, both 2016-12-29: S1 "The Careless but Loveable Cute Junior" (うっかり者だが愛され上手の可愛い後輩) and S2 "Ai and Private Film". TVDB 318271 season 0: 0x1 "The Careless but Loveable Cute Junior" and 0x2 "Ai and Private Film", both 2016-12-29; 0x3 "Part 13" (2021) belongs to the sequel. Titles identical, order identical. Parent has no mapping list.
